concept: S3 encryption: SSE-KMS with a customer managed key
tests: Choosing an S3 at-rest encryption option that gives full control over keys and auditing of every key use with the LEAST operational overhead.
expected: SSE-KMS with a customer managed KMS key + CloudTrail: the company controls the key policy and rotation, and every key use is logged automatically. Triggers: "full control over keys" + "key usage logged/audit" + "least operational overhead".
why_not: SSE-S3 — AWS holds the keys, no key-usage audit; SSE-C and client-side — the company builds and operates key management itself (high overhead).
